MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls | Year 1 DLC Character - Thor (Jane Foster)
Thor (Jane Foster), the second DLC character in the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, is coming to MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls!

As the Mighty Thor, Jane Foster wields the legendary Mjolnir and will unleashing the electrifying power of the God of Thunder upon the battlefield!
Coming this Winter!

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is available now on PS5 and PC!
